facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance says fibre deployment guidelines validated on 4 June 2025 are meant to support implementation of the National Broadband Policy 2018.

The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance held a validation workshop on 4 June 2025 on draft guidelines for ICT infrastructure in buildings, roads and transport, with private telecom industry and professional bodies taking part, after stakeholder consultations in 2024/25.
